## Endpoint

```
POST /api/example/messages
```

## Request body

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | Yes | Message text |
| `to` | string | Yes | Recipient |

## Example

```python
import requests

requests.post("https://example.test/api/example/messages", json={"text": "hi", "to": "1"})
```
